svg.title: RNA-seq to mature miRNA prediction: approach and study comparisons
svg.desc: Paired RNA-seq and mature-miRNA measurements support model development and evaluation. The final P1 browser model accepts RNA-seq alone, using 1963 genes to estimate 465 mature miRNAs. Separate plots show original cancer-excluded TCGA ridge input comparisons and current final-procedure CPTAC-3 and liver correlation comparisons. Populations, target coverage and model stages differ. External cohort whiskers are saved 95 percent bootstrap intervals; TCGA values are pooled point estimates.

g.text: A Model development and RNA-only application
Fitted separately on all TCGA development specimens
